crossRefs.note: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing…
Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his…
If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you…
For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn’t the Father’s…
Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

translations.web: “I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
translations.bsb: “I have made a covenant with my eyes. How then could I gaze with desire at a virgin?
translations.kjv: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
translations.asv: I made a covenant with mine eyes; How then should I look upon a virgin?
